metadata.description: xos — Exponential OS for Exponential Orgs, Humans, and More 2.0 (a play on the Singularity University book by Salim Ismail). The platform marketplace catalog hosted by Exponential-OS. Hosts the xOS family — AI-native operating systems for humans (xHumanOS), teams (xTeamOS), communities (xCommunityOS), families (xFamilyOS), and beyond — plus standalone tools (Co-Dialectic) and apps (Career-OS). Plugins install as @xos.

plugins.name: co-dialectic
plugins.description: Co-Dialectic v4.7.0 — LLM prompt optimizer + onboarding skill (new users get value in ≤5 min) + external-ready (no personal content) + compaction immunity + semantic T3 classification + fish-swarm + Protocol 0 post-compaction re-init. Cross-family judge-panel, hallucination detector, session handoff. Works with any LLM runtime.

plugins.name: career-os
plugins.description: Career OS — AI-powered career management system. The operating system for your career — persistent memory, session capture, git-versioned data, full privacy. v0.46.0: Gate 9 golden-hour-scheduling-check (warns on off-window scheduling per platform); v0.45.0: Gate 8 invisible signal CTAs; v0.44.1: preflight severity fix; v0.44.0: Gate 8 CTA quality; v0.43.0: Gate 7 estate quality.
